title: Excaliburt Additions
description: A resource pack that enhances mod textures.
body:
This resource pack ports several textures (and also includes newly created ones) inspired by the Excalibur resource pack.

Texture support:

Unseen's Nether Backport
Future MC
End's Delight
Nether's Delight
Baubles
Armiger
JEI
XpBook
Enchanter Tools
Ice and Fire
Aether Legacy
Spartan Weaponry
Mowzie's Mobs

Note: Some textures were not replaced because they could not be modified properly (such as the Aerwhale and the Mowzie's Mobs boss helmet). A version for **Electroblob's Wizardry** will be released soon.
